answer: What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round.
